observações: Higher tolerance makes early stopping more likely. Used in histogram-based gradient boosting.

descrição do parâmetro: Tolerance for stopping criteria with stricter range.

descrição do parâmetro: Tolerance for stopping criterion.
observações: Typically used in algorithms requiring precise convergence.
